decisions.reason: The required photo selection supplies content for the separate photo-treatment Requirement but does not change the existing full-document layout or graphic-treatment rules.
Selecting asterisk-marked photos does not change the Agua Arc brand identity or the brand assets to apply.
The source specifies which photos to include and does not change the required budget-sheet or table integration.
The photo-selection instruction does not alter Canva source delivery, edit access, ownership, subscription, or asset-policy requirements.
The source concerns proposal imagery and does not change narrative content integration or the fixed section order.
Selecting required photos does not change the final PDF format, file count, email submission method, or export-quality constraints.
The source applies to the separate GreenLatinos RFQ document and does not modify the TPEC proposal design.
The photo-selection instruction does not change the permitted number of revision rounds.
The source provides an input artifact but does not change any draft, revision, submission, or deadline date in the delivery schedule.
The instruction to include selected photos does not revise the anticipated page-count constraint.
